Title: Submission - Server Intrusion (auspex bleed discards cards instead)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Server Intrusion
Cardtype: Action modifier
[aus] Only usable when a bleed would be successful. The bleed burns no pool; it is unsuccessful. Instead, look at the hand of the target Methuselah and discard up to X cards among them, where X is the bleed amount.
[AUS] As above, but you choose and discard the cards one by one (the target Methuselah replaces immediately after each discard; you don't see the last card replaced).

World of Darkness reference: Bleeding is conceptually the act of "paying bribes, changing bank records, spreading rumors, etc." This card burns cards instead of burning pool.
Game references: Revelations, Spying Mission.

How does this card address a compelling game need? Even though it's usually better to burn pool than discarding cards, there are some cases where cards in hand are more important than pool (eg. your prey is at 20 pool and you just need to discard his combat cards). It can be used on a harmless looking bleed for 1 but also if the bleed is redirected.

Created by: Ankha

Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Hum... you will end discarding cards from the wrong player... it might be good... you might be helping your ally by discarding junk that he does not need...

I would prefer something like:

[aus] Only usable after a successful bleed. The target player burn x cards from the top of his library where x is the amount of the bleed.
[AUS] As above, but the cards are not burned but removed from the game instead.
